rows.note: Use 細菌 as the everyday all-purpose term, especially when talking about microbes as germs or harmful bacteria.

example.english: A microbe can easily spread from a hand to food.
example.traditional: 一粒細菌好容易由隻手傳到食物度。
example.jyutping: jat1 nap1 sai3 kwan2 hou2 jung4 ji6 jau4 zek3 sau2 cyun4 dou3 sik6 mat6 dou6

rows.note: Use 微生物 for the scientifically precise sense of any microorganism, including harmless ones.

example.english: This microbe is harmless to humans.
example.traditional: 呢種微生物對人體冇害。
example.jyutping: ne1 zung2 mei4 sang1 mat6 deoi3 jan4 tai2 mou5 hoi6

rows.note: Use 病菌 when the microbe is specifically being identified as disease-causing.

example.english: The doctor said a microbe had gotten into the wound, so I need antibiotics.
example.traditional: 醫生話傷口入咗病菌，所以要食抗生素。
example.jyutping: ji1 saang1 waa6 soeng1 hau2 jap6 zo2 beng6 kwan2 so2 ji5 jiu3 sik6 kong3 saang1 sou3
